gloss: to throw away; to toss carelessly; to abandon

definitions.gloss: to throw; to toss; to hurl carelessly
definitions.explanation: To throw something with a careless or forceful motion, without much concern for where it lands.

definitions.gloss: to abandon; to give up on; to quit partway through
definitions.explanation: To stop doing something midway and walk away from it. Implies irresponsibility or frustration.

examples.japanese: ボールを{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる。
かばんを{床|ゆか}に{放|ほう}り{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I tossed my bag onto the floor.

examples.japanese: {怒|おこ}って{本|ほん}を{壁|かべ}に{放|ほう}り{投|な}げた。
examples.english: In anger, I hurled the book at the wall.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}を{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる。
{途中|とちゅう}で{嫌|いや}になって{全部|ぜんぶ}{放|ほう}り{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I got fed up partway through and abandoned everything.

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}ある{立場|たちば}の{人|ひと}が{仕事|しごと}を{放|ほう}り{投|な}げるのは{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: It's unacceptable for someone in a position of responsibility to abandon their work.

notes:
A compound verb from {放|ほう}る (to throw, to toss) + {投|な}げる (to throw). The combination intensifies the carelessness or force of the throw. Both senses carry a nuance of roughness or disregard.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仕事|しごと}を{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to abandon one's work
- ボールを{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to toss a ball
- {全部|ぜんぶ}{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to give up on everything
- {途中|とちゅう}で{放|ほう}り{投|な}げる — to quit midway

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {投|な}げ{出|だ}す — to throw out, to abandon (very similar to sense 2; equally common)
- {放|ほう}り{出|だ}す — to throw out, to eject (emphasizes expulsion or abandonment)
- {投|な}げる — to throw (neutral; lacks the careless or rough nuance)
